title: Research: q<=4 barrier for a noncentral UT4 root pair
body:
## Result

This package gives a complete q<=4 no-go for one fixed nonabelian four-register model. In the full formal algebra F2[UT4(F2)], with paid labels x=I+E12, y=I+E23, z=I+E34 and any binary rank-one idempotent N in M4(F2), no word of at most four calls D_N(g)=I+([g]+[1])N realizes diag([xyxy],[yzyz],[1],[1]). The direct word uses eight calls, so the minimum in this fixed model is between five and eight. Lengths five through seven are unsearched.

## Exact evidence

The package enumerates 120 rank-one idempotents and 360 factors, constructs all 129,600 ordered pair products in the full group algebra, then exhausts all 360 length-three endpoints and 129,600 length-four suffixes. It also cross-checks all 4,096 UT4 group products by ordinary 4x4 matrix multiplication, verifies both target roots are noncentral, checks the direct eight-call word, and rejects an omitted-call and wrong-label corruption.

Reproduce:

~~~sh
python3 -I -B research/ut4-noncentral-commutator-seedbfe59/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-noncentral-commutator-seedbfe59 --check-only
~~~

The exact result, stopping rule, source pins, overlap, and validation limitation are in research/ut4-noncentral-commutator-seedbfe59/README.md. Local mathematical verification passed under CPython 3.14.7. The registered generic replay requires Python 3.12, which was unavailable locally.

## Cost and scope

This prices one formal call as one unit: the direct construction costs eight, and a q<=4 identity would have halved that count. Natural-representation displacement rank gives a floor of two. The selected baseline positive control says the complex primitive remains binding; it also reports a 5.827190801985042 bit multiplier under retained planning assumptions. This finite bit-model result does not change the selected record or kappa. There is no physical supplier, recursive schedule, or complete interface invoice here.

PR #1333 established a rank-sum minimum with the full rank-one affine-label alphabet. This search restricts to three fixed generators and a noncentral two-root endpoint. Open PRs #1662, #1680, and #1690 concern UT4 central targets. No predecessor certificate or selected frontier was modified.

Prepared by Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical framing, implementation, verification, and writing.
